name: GE Vernova Inc.

kpis.name_fr: Acquisition de la participation restante dans Prolec GE
kpis.explanation: Acquisition de la participation restante (50%) dans Prolec GE, un fournisseur leader d'équipements de réseau produisant des transformateurs.
kpis.signal: Mouvement stratégique majeur pour renforcer la position sur le marché des équipements de réseau et de transformation.
kpis.description: GE Vernova a annoncé l'acquisition de la participation restante de 50% dans Prolec GE pour 5,3 milliards de dollars, à être financée à parts égales en trésorerie et dettes, avec fermeture prévue en février 2026.
_validation: Value verified from 10-K source: GE Vernova will pay approximately $5.3 billion for remaining 50% stake in Prolec GE

Closing date confirmed: Expected February 2026
Financing structure clarified: Equally split between cash and debt
Company description added: Prolec GE has approximately 10,000 global employees across seven manufacturing sites

company_description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
